info.title: Ferry Staff API
info.description: Schedule and riding API contract. Schedule endpoints are read-only; departure-notification subscriptions use a private per-device bearer token. Display payload schemaVersion remains 11. Additive properties are allowed; clients must tolerate unknown fields. Schedule IDs are opaque strings. Timestamps are UTC ISO-8601, service dates use meta.timezone, and schedule seconds may exceed 86400. /api/override has been removed.

routes.description: Routes across every landing, keyed by the feed's namespaced route ID, for per-device operator and route filters.

seconds.description: Seconds since local service-day midnight; may exceed 86400.

liveTripIdsByDate.description: Verified live trip IDs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD service date. Select this date before falling back to the ordinary ID. A nyc:unmapped: fallback intentionally matches no live feed entity.

predictTripIdsByDate.description: Verified live trip IDs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD service date. Select this date before falling back to the ordinary ID. A nyc:unmapped: fallback intentionally matches no live feed entity.

feedArrivalSeconds.description: Original operator arrival baseline retained when a published timetable supplies a separate arrival before dwell.

nextLiveTripIdsByDate.description: Verified live trip IDs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD service date. Select this date before falling back to the ordinary ID. A nyc:unmapped: fallback intentionally matches no live feed entity.

liveTripIdsByDate.description: Verified live trip IDs keyed by YYYY-MM-DD service date. Select this date before falling back to the ordinary ID. A nyc:unmapped: fallback intentionally matches no live feed entity.

arrivalDelaySeconds.description: Arrival delay relative to the published arrival, when it differs from delaySeconds (departure).

id.description: Stable fleet ID or nycf: provider vehicle ID; never a feed entity ID.

arrivalAt.description: Unix epoch milliseconds. Uses a fresh arrival estimate when present, otherwise the schedule.

confirmedAt.description: Observation timestamp in Unix epoch milliseconds; confirms assignment, not actual arrival.

HarborAssignment.description: Which run a vessel is estimated to be working. source says how it is known, most trusted first: operator-rt, schedule, run, pattern, model.

vessel.description: The fleet database record; null for an unrostered vessel.

links.description: Transponders linked to this hull and how each link is known.

references.description: Where each researched fact came from.

estimates.description: Stored estimates for today, with reasoning and evidence.
